reason: Reproduced with installed uv 0.12.13 (Linux x86_64 GNU), Python 3.12.3, and isolated local mock endpoints. Ran `uv sync --no-index --no-config --python /usr/bin/python3 --no-python-downloads --keyring-provider disabled --preview-features gcs-endpoint` with UV_GCS_ENDPOINT_URL targeting the mock wheel endpoint, GCE_METADATA_HOST targeting mock metadata, and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing to a synthetic external_account configuration without credential_source.format. uv fetched mock metadata credentials, retried the wheel request with an Authorization header, and reported the fixture's 403 without a credential-loading diagnostic. Adding -v still hid the error; RUST_LOG=reqsign_core=debug showed the untagged Source parsing error and successful metadata-provider selection. Adding "format": {"type": "text"} avoided metadata, used the mock external-account exchange, and completed successfully. The reported uv 0.12.23 musl/GKE environment was not tested. No real credentials were accessed. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md and retained the reproduction harness and results; checkout and GitHub state were unchanged.
